ayahs.tr: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ayahs.tl: Ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

ayahs.tr: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.tl: Wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

ayahs.tr: So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]
